headline.one_concrete_circuit: a series high-speed DC-rated fuse in the DC bus (in the internal discharge loop), the existing line-to-neutral MOV for the surge case, and the existing line fuse for the line-fed case

F2.placement: in series in the DC bus between the boost-diode U10 cathode and the capacitor bank (on PFC_BUS_PLUS_390V)
F2.why_in_the_loop: the internal discharge loop is caps -> shorted U10 -> a1 -> U9 -> caps; a series element in the bus between the cap bank and the boost stage carries the entire discharge and opens the path regardless of U9's health
F2.rating_source: raw/fwp-1-50a.pdf (Cooper Bussmann High Speed Fuses, Data Sheet 720025, FWP 690V/700V 1-50 A)
F2.continuous_duty: normal bus current ~4.49 A average, ~7.05 A peak (rectified) vs 50 A rating; the fault pulse, not the average, is the binding sizing case

U7.role: line-to-neutral surge clamp (diverts; does not interrupt)
U7.required_clamp_characteristic: V_clamp(I_MOV) read from the LA Series Transient V-I curve (Figure 10, 14 mm parts) at the actual MOV surge current; that current is not established, so the required clamp is null

F1.role: only series interrupting element in the line-fed loop

a_U10_short_u9_healthy.detection_latency_budget_required: there is no loop-current sensor: the shunt U12 is not in the internal loop and the controller has no OCP. A dedicated in-loop current sense plus a desaturating gate drive, tripping inside the U9 short-circuit SOA, would be required; no such budget is established.

b_U10_short_u9_failed_short.statement: U9 cannot be turned off. The series fuse F2 is the only element that can act, and whether it clears at 400 Vdc for a capacitor-discharge pulse is NOT demonstrated. If demonstrated clearing is required, NO available part interrupts case (b).

c_line_fed_switch_short.statement: F1 is the only series element by topology, but its breaking capacity is 160 A at 250 VAC and the prospective line current is unknown; coordination with the surviving bridge/switch SOA is not demonstrated. F2 is not in this loop and does not help.

d_line_surge.statement: the MOV clamps. The required clamp at the operating surge current cannot be resolved because that current is not established; 395 V max at 50 A is an upper bound at that current only. The surge contract is PROVISIONAL/ASSUMED.

e_cannot_interrupt: the internal discharge if F2 does not clear (clearing not demonstrated)
any already-bolted short (no gate command opens a failed-short device)
a crowbar alone (diverts, does not interrupt; not part of this arrangement)
a line-fed fault below F1's clearing threshold
line-to-PE / common-mode surge (the MOV is line-to-neutral only)
case (b) if demonstrated clearing is required

pulse_and_sizing.waveform: unidirectional decaying exponential i(t) = (V0/R) exp(-t/(R C)), V0 = 400 V, C = 2240.47 uF
pulse_and_sizing.waveform_validity: assumes an overdamped non-inductive loop with a single lumped R; AR-PROTECT's receipt states the normal-device resistance does not describe a destructive fault
what_would_size_it: the internal loop's high-current impedance model: U10 failed-short residual, U9 failed-short residual, capacitor-bank ESR at the discharge frequency, fuse resistance and layout
the FWP-50A14F DC let-through / clearing characteristic for a 400 Vdc capacitor-discharge waveshape (not the published AC/inductive clearing I2t)
a sourced withstand I2t for the capacitor bank and the PCB copper, to compare against the fuse let-through

reasons: the prospective internal-loop peak current and action I2t are not established (loop impedance unknown)
the fuse clearing I2t is published for an AC/inductive test at rated voltage, not a 400 Vdc capacitor discharge
the let-through I2t is not compared against a sourced withstand I2t for the capacitor bank or PCB copper
the line-fed prospective current and F1's total clearing at matching conditions are not established
what_is_shown: F2's DC voltage rating (800 Vdc) exceeds the 400 V bus, and its DC breaking capacity (50 kA at 800 Vdc) is published
F2 melts for any loop resistance below 0.896 ohm under the illustrative series-R-C model
F2 carries the normal bus current with wide margin

completion_ladder.note: advanced one rung at a time; promoted none -> protection_identified -> part_selected; NOT promoted to coordination_demonstrated

single_most_important_missing_input: The internal discharge loop's high-current impedance at the fault (U10/U9 failed-short residual + bank ESR + fuse + layout). It sets the prospective peak current and the action I2t, and therefore decides whether the selected FWP-50A14F both melts and clears inside its 400 Vdc capacitor-discharge rating. Until it exists, coordination for case (b) cannot be demonstrated and the honest verdict is that no available part is shown to interrupt it.
